text: dsh-autoresearch（DSH 插件，通用客户端）：为 DSH agent 提供有界、以基线为先的指标优化实验。插件注册 autoresearch 工具，并将任务作为后台 job 运行，也可使用前台模式；agent 在隔离的 Git worktree 中按允许修改的路径提出候选改动，由 Host 注册的 evaluator 执行评估，只有指标严格改善的候选才会保留。它记录实验状态和结果，支持查看、取消与恢复。适合希望在自己的 Git 仓库中反复比较量化指标的开发者。使用前需要 Host 配置 evaluator 注册及 DSH 所需服务，并安装可用的 Git。

dsh-autoresearch is a DSH plugin for bounded metric optimization. An agent proposes changes in an isolated Git worktree; a Host evaluator measures them, and only strict improvements are kept. Runs can be managed as background jobs. The Host must configure an evaluator and provide Git.
我想让 agent 在隔离的 Git 分支里反复改代码，并按一个数值指标保留更好的版本。
能不能先跑一次基线，再让 DSH 按我定义的评估器做有限轮优化？
我希望把长时间的优化实验放到后台，并能查看或取消任务。
怎样让 agent 只修改指定路径，然后用本机 evaluator 衡量改动效果？
I want an agent to run bounded experiments in a Git worktree and keep only metric improvements.
Can DSH run a baseline-first optimization loop as a background job that I can inspect or stop?
dsh-autoresearch 的功能「基线指标优化」：在隔离 Git worktree 中由 agent 提出限定路径的改动，再由 Host evaluator 测量；仅保留指标严格改善的候选。通过 autoresearch 工具启动。
dsh-autoresearch 的功能「后台实验任务」：autoresearch 默认将优化运行交给 DSH jobs 后台执行，工具返回任务标识供通用 job 工具检查或停止，也支持前台运行。
dsh-autoresearch 的功能「实验记录与恢复」：运行状态和结果写入持久化 tracker；控制器为运行分配状态目录并读取已有记录，以便恢复运行或检查实验结果。
dsh-autoresearch 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 12 天；提交数 14；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

Unofficial, third-party plugin for bounded, metric-driven optimization in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), inspired by [Karpathy's autoresearch](https://github.com/karpathy/autoresearch).

**Independent project:** `dsh-autoresearch` is maintained by [EveGoodEvening](https://github.com/EveGoodEvening). It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by DeepSeek or Andrej Karpathy.

dsh-autoresearch README · dsh-autoresearch：The `autoresearch` tool measures a baseline, lets an agent edit allowed files in an isolated Git worktree, and keeps only strict improvements. The Host controls evaluation; SQLite records results for inspection and recovery.

dsh-autoresearch README · Supported versions：Tested pairing and packed-consumer/Web-profile smoke verified on **2026-10-31**. Use the **scoped Cordis fork**, not unscoped `cordis`. DSH's plugin check uses `engines.dsh`, so any `0.2.1` prerelease from `rc.2` through the final `0.2.1` is accepted; `0.2.2` prereleases are excluded because they remove an API this plugin uses. Daily [upstream compatibility checks](https://github.com/EveGoodEvening/dsh-autoresearch/blob/master/.github/workflows/compatibility.yml) do not automatically expand these ranges.

dsh-autoresearch README · Supported versions：The Node.js security floors include the October 2026 TLS/Brotli fixes and
[eMudhra CA remediation](https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/). Keep the Host
runtime and its operating-system CA store patched; a plugin lockfile cannot
update either. Dependency audits include development and optional packages and
fail at **low** severity rather than hiding lower-severity findings.

dsh-autoresearch README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-autoresearch
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config
```

The dump should contain `id: autoresearch` and `name: dsh-autoresearch`. Use `dsh plugin`, not plain `pnpm add`, to activate the bundle.

The Host needs `agents`, `jobs`, `subprocess`, `systemPrompt`, and `tools`. Background runs also need `dsh-tool-jobs` in the calling Agent; the Web `standard` preset and base/headless compositions provide it.

dsh-autoresearch README · Use：**Register an evaluator first.** The Host-owned `evaluatorRegistrations` registry is intentionally empty by default: the agent cannot choose an arbitrary evaluator command. Here is a complete toy setup; the Host evaluator computes the distance to 3, rather than trusting a model-reported score. It demonstrates the protocol, not scientific effectiveness.

dsh-autoresearch README · `cordis.patch.yml`：Profile overrides replace the **whole row config**, not a deep merge. This minimal row retains the required run defaults; the [Config schema](https://github.com/EveGoodEvening/dsh-autoresearch/blob/master/src/config.ts) materializes omitted deployment defaults from the [shipped patch](cordis.patch.yml). Retain any existing deployment overrides, model-routing settings and evaluator registrations when replacing the row. Restart the profile and inspect `dsh --profile <name> --dump-config` before use.

dsh-autoresearch README · `cordis.patch.yml`：`node` must be available to the Host. The evaluator runs shell-free with fixed argv; omitting `cwd` selects the isolated evaluation worktree root. It must exit successfully and end stdout with a JSON object containing **exactly one key**, the registered metric name, with a finite numeric value: this baseline ends with `{"distance":7}`. Earlier stdout may contain logs; do not add trailing blank lines. `judge.mjs` is protected against candidate edits. This example explicitly uses no dataset; the schema also supports protected local dataset files or an externally identified dataset.

dsh-autoresearch README · Call `autoresearch`：- `repository` defaults to the agent's working directory. Use a fresh, Git-safe `run_tag` for each new run.
- Runs are background jobs by default. Inspect or stop them with `job_list`, `job_output`, and `job_kill`; use `"mode": "foreground"` to wait for completion.
- Cancellation waits for evaluator cleanup, reconciles the accepted Git state, and releases the run lock only after durable terminal settlement.
- Plugin unload or hot reload cancels active runs and waits for proposal children and jobs to settle.
- Optional inputs: `target` (stopping threshold), `timeout_ms` (per-attempt watchdog), and `constraints` (advisory guidance, not acceptance rules).
- To resume, replace `run_tag` and `evaluator_id` with `resume_run_id` and retain the original run policy. The stored evaluator registration is revalidated before execution.

dsh-autoresearch README · Call `autoresearch`：Defaults: **20 candidates**, deployment cap **100**, **15-minute evaluator watchdog per attempt** (Host cap **60 minutes**), and **one active run per repository**. The baseline is separate from the candidate cap. Git has independent Host-only limits: `gitTimeoutMs` defaults to **900000** (integer range **1–2147483647**); `gitMaxStdoutBytes` and `gitMaxStderrBytes` each default to **1048576**, independently of evaluator output caps. See [Config](https://github.com/EveGoodEvening/dsh-autoresearch/blob/master/src/config.ts) for deployment limits and retention.

dsh-autoresearch README · Behavior and safety：- **Bounded scalar search.** Baseline first; one minimized or maximized scalar, strict improvement only. `constraints` and approval guidance are advisory, not acceptance rules or permission grants. Hard human approval must be enforced by Host policy. This does not establish scientific efficacy or fair resource allocation.
- **Narrow changes, bounded provenance.** Only `mutable_globs` may change; declared evaluator/local dataset files are read-only to candidates. SQLite records decisions and bounded evaluator/dataset/policy evidence; resume revalidates it and fails closed on mismatch or legacy registrations. This is not a complete runtime-image identity.
- **Managed execution, not confinement.** Evaluation uses `ctx.subprocess` for fixed shell-free argv/environment, bounded stdout/stderr collection, a per-attempt watchdog, cancellation/termination and process-tree quiescence checks before continuation. Completion waits for managed cleanup; a watchdog is not a compute budget.
